environment.execution: outside the agent tool sandbox; user terminal failure reproduced here

observedCause: In the normal Windows environment, system-CA mode rejected the explicitly loaded self-signed ERP certificate with DEPTH_ZERO_SELF_SIGNED_CERT. The same approved certificate passed native TLS and Playwright with system-CA mode disabled. Windows TLS validated the same fingerprint. This is an observed mode interaction, not a claim about its internal Node/OpenSSL cause.
fix: Load NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS before Node starts and pass --no-use-system-ca for the explicit Windows CA configuration; certificate and hostname verification remain enabled.
